chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Faḍḍāl, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿIsa, from al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Faḍḍāl.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, the author’s immediate transmitter in this chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Faḍḍāl in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Faḍḍāl in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It is part of the work’s transmission documentation and helps establish the source line for hadith attribution.
